GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Does every pole need a foundation?

Requirements depend on the pole system and site. Permanent ground-mounted, wall-mounted and temporary systems need different preparation. The quote identifies the work needed for the chosen arrangement.

Can you use my existing flagpole or foundation?

Existing components need review before reuse can be agreed. Send photos, approximate dimensions and any product or installation records you have.

Do you handle site approvals?

Tell us about owner permissions, venue rules and any applicable local requirements. Responsibility for approvals and specialist input must be agreed in the installation scope.
